note: Style bible v1 plus face rules for every native head view (head SPR 0-4), added 2026-10-02 for the completion milestone. Palette, skin tags and all thresholds are copied unchanged from v1; v1 stays the bible of the saved packs. Native face numbers for slots without a recorded entry are measured from the pinned native drawing with the same rule that produced head:1 (verify_candidate.gd prints them, and the gate records them in every result).

materials.skinNote: Palette indices counted as face skin. Derived with verify_candidate.gd --derive, then reviewed. Very light hair could be counted as skin; the face check only looks at the lower 55% of the head.

head.faceViewsNote: Head SPR 0 (S), 1 (SW) and 2 (W profile) show the face: the v1 rule (at least 80% of the native face skin, face box within 2 px) applies to each slot's own native face. SPR 3 (NW) and 4 (N) are rear views: the visible skin (cheek, ear, nape) must stay within 50%-150% of the native visible skin, plus or minus 4 px, so a rear head can neither lose its visible skin nor gain a frontal face. A head slot without a listed view fails the gate.
head.why: The head is a shared module: native hats are drawn and anchored for the native skull, and RO identity depends on the large rounded face. Head size is a template rule, not a per-character choice (user review 2026-09-25).

body.why: Costumes may change the silhouette a little, but hands, feet and neck must stay where the native ACT expects them.

head:1.derivedBy: verify_candidate.gd --derive (largest skin component in the lower 55% of the native head)

designRules: Mirrored views flip asymmetric details (inspection B7): a hip pouch changes sides between S and E. Design costumes to tolerate the flip, or keep key details symmetric.
Raw SPR head and body slots face LEFT; the game mirrors them. Prompts must follow the slot's facing, not the design reference's.
Body boards are headless; head boards are heads only (face and hair, no neck, body or headgear). Headgear is a separate native module that sits on the native skull.
Rear head views (SPR 3, 4) show hair and only the native amount of cheek/ear/nape skin; never a face.
